items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: I played with Bonnie Bigard and myself. Little Scram band, Buddy PT

ctx.x: Is that the end of the music? Yeah, that's it.

Yeah, back in the day, as far as I can remember, I played with Bonnie Bigard and myself. Little Scram band, Buddy PT, you know, back in the... That band wasn't rated with these bands like this. I mean, they played... Just gig around, you know. Lot of colored work. For the white people, they played most of the poor class of people, you know.
Where did you work with Buddy PT?
